wiki_catalogs.name: Getting Started
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive getting started content for Project Anime, a full-stack streaming application. Explain the project's purpose as a multi-format content platform supporting anime, movies, dramas, manga, and manhwa with cross-platform deployment capabilities. Document the complete installation process including Node.js requirements, dependency installation, environment setup, and development server configuration. Provide step-by-step instructions for running the development server, building production versions, and setting up the mobile app using Capacitor. Include basic usage examples showing how to navigate the application, search for content, and access different media types. Address common setup issues and provide troubleshooting guidance for initial configuration. Make the content accessible to developers new to the project while ensuring experienced developers can quickly get up and running.

wiki_catalogs.name: System Design
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive system design documentation for Project Anime's full-stack architecture. Describe the high-level system as a cross-platform streaming platform with React frontend, Express.js backend, and Capacitor-based mobile application. Document the technology stack decisions including React 19 for UI, Vite for build optimization, HLS.js for adaptive video streaming, Supabase for real-time data synchronization, and @consumet/extensions for content provider abstraction. Explain the architectural patterns used such as feature-based modular organization, provider pattern for content sources, cache-aside caching strategy, and proxy pattern for CORS handling. Include system context diagrams showing how web clients, mobile apps, backend services, and external APIs interact. Detail infrastructure requirements, scalability considerations, and deployment topology across different environments.

# Project Anime: Comprehensive Streaming Platform Analysis

## 1. Project Introduction

**Project Anime** is a comprehensive multi-platform streaming application that provides anime, movies, dramas, and manga content through a unified interface. Built with modern web technologies and designed for both web and mobile deployment via Capacitor, this project serves as a complete entertainment platform targeting anime enthusiasts and general media consumers.

### Purpose Statement
The application aims to provide a seamless streaming experience across multiple content types (anime, movies, dramas, manga) with features like watch history synchronization, playlist management, and cross-device compatibility.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Multi-format Content Support**: Unified interface for anime, movies, dramas, and manga reading
- **Cross-Platform Deployment**: Web application with native mobile app capabilities via Capacitor
- **User Experience**: Netflix-style browsing with personalized recommendations and watch history
- **Content Discovery**: Advanced search, categorization, and recommendation systems
- **Cloud Synchronization**: User data persistence across devices using Supabase

### Target Audience
- Anime enthusiasts seeking diverse content sources
- Users wanting a unified streaming platform
- Mobile users requiring native app functionality
- Users interested in manga/manhwa reading experiences

## 2. Technical Architecture

The application follows a modern React-based architecture with a sophisticated backend proxy system for content aggregation and streaming.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[React Frontend] --> B[API Layer]
    B --> C[Backend Proxy Server]
    C --> D[Content Providers]
    C --> E[Streaming Services]
    C --> F[Metadata APIs]
    
    G[Capacitor Mobile App] --> A
    H[Supabase Auth] --> A
    I[Local Storage] --> A
    
    D --> J[AniList API]
    D --> K[HiAnime Provider]
    D --> L[AnimeKai Scraper]
    D --> M[Consumet Extensions]
    
    E --> N[HLS.js Player]
    E --> O[M3U8 Proxy]
    E --> P[TS Segment Proxy]
```

### Component Breakdown

**Frontend Architecture:**
- **React 19** with Vite build system for optimal performance
- **Feature-based organization** with modular components for each content type
- **State management** using React hooks with localStorage persistence
- **Responsive design** supporting mobile, tablet, and desktop views

**Backend Architecture:**
- **Express.js server** handling API requests and content scraping
- **Multiple provider integration** with fallback mechanisms
- **Caching system** for improved performance and rate limit management
- **Proxy services** for CORS bypass and stream protection

**Mobile Integration:**
- **Capacitor framework** for native app packaging
- **Native plugins** for splash screen, status bar, and file system access
- **Deep linking support** for external content navigation

### Design Patterns

The application implements several key design patterns:

1. **Provider Pattern**: Multiple content providers with automatic fallback
2. **Cache-Aside Pattern**: In-memory caching with TTL for API responses
3. **Strategy Pattern**: Different streaming strategies based on content type
4. **Observer Pattern**: Real-time updates for user authentication and notifications

### System Relationships

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant F as Frontend
    participant B as Backend
    participant P as Provider
    participant S as Stream Service
    
    U->>F: Request Content
    F->>B: API Call
    B->>P: Fetch Metadata
    P-->>B: Return Data
    B->>S: Get Stream URL
    S-->>B: Stream Link
    B-->>F: Response
    F->>U: Display Content
```

**Application Bootstrap:**

**Streaming Infrastructure:**

**Content Providers:**

## 4. Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Multi-Format Content Support:**
- **Anime Streaming**: Full episode support with multiple quality options and language variants
- **Movie Collection**: Extensive movie library with detailed metadata and ratings
- **Drama Series**: Korean, Japanese, and other international drama content
- **Manga/Manhwa Reading**: Digital comic reader with chapter navigation and progress tracking

**User Experience Features:**
- **Netflix-style Interface**: Horizontal scrolling rows with featured content carousels
- **Advanced Search**: Multi-source search with filtering by genre, year, and rating
- **Personalization**: Watch history, favorites, and custom playlists
- **Cross-Device Sync**: Cloud synchronization of user preferences and progress

**Technical Features:**
- **Adaptive Streaming**: HLS.js integration for optimal video quality based on bandwidth
- **Offline Support**: Local caching for improved performance and offline viewing
- **Mobile Optimization**: Touch-friendly interface with native app capabilities
- **Accessibility**: Keyboard navigation and screen reader support

### Implementation Highlights

**User Management:**

- `src/utils/storage.js` - Local storage abstraction with encryption support
- Real-time sync engine for cloud data synchronization

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Home

    Read --> Reader: Open Chapter
    
    Player --> [*]: Exit
    Reader --> [*]: Exit
    Detail --> [*]: Back
```

**Content Provider System:**
- Primary providers with automatic fallback to secondary sources
- Caching layer for improved performance and reduced API calls
- Error handling with graceful degradation when providers are unavailable

**Mobile Application Features:**

- Deep linking support for external content navigation
- Background playback and notification support
